links.comparator_used: Base LLMs (GPT-5-chat and Qwen3.5-27B) responding without the safety governance architecture, as implied by the reported gain in clinician-preferred escalation responses
links.outcome: Risk detection performance and clinician-preferred escalation responses in multi-turn synthetic mental health conversations
links.effect: Specificity 0.85 (95%CI: 0.78;0.91), sensitivity 0.92 (95%CI: 0.88;0.95); clinician-preferred escalation responses increased by 25.6–59.2 pp; rapport and connection preserved; stable across conversation length and across proprietary and open-source models
links.quote: increasing clinician-preferred escalation responses by 25.6–59.2 pp while preserving rapport and connection

design_hint: risk detection and protocol-guided escalation safety layer
